collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager has tasted every fruit on the island but one, a smelly spiky swamp fruit: eat it, or let one fruit stay a mystery.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Years ago (subject) decided to taste every kind of fruit on Isola. (subject.He/she) has kept count on a string with knots. (subject.He/she) has tasted every kind but one: a lumpy, spiky fruit that grows by the swamp and smells, people agree, like old fish left out in the sun. Today (friend) has found a ripe one and brought it over, holding it at arm's length.

choices.label: Decide One Fruit Can Stay a Mystery

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) holds (subject.his/her) nose and takes a bite. (subject.He/she) chews. (subject.He/she) stops. An odd look crosses (subject.his/her) face. "It's... actually delicious," (subject.he/she) says. (friend) doesn't believe a word of it and refuses to try. (subject) ties the last knot in the string, and then, after a moment, asks for another piece.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) looks at the fruit. (subject.He/she) smells it. (subject.He/she) hands it back. "I think I'll leave one," (subject.he/she) says, "so there's still something to wonder about." (friend) is relieved and throws it as far as possible. The string stays one knot short. (subject) seems to like it that way.
